name: sale-availability-assessment
description: Deterministic sale-availability assessments linked to their address, optional independently established property, and sorted listing-observation evidence.

datasets.description: One row per sale_availability_assessment@1.0.0 with explicit Sale Availability relationship references.

relationships.description: Explicit endpoint references. A relationship is emitted only when both endpoint records exist.

sale_availability_assessment_has_address.description: Reference to the existing address subject. This reference never establishes property identity.

sale_availability_assessment_has_listing.description: Ascending, bytewise-sorted observation identifiers used as assessment evidence.

sale_availability_assessment_has_propert.description: Reference to an independently established property identity, or null when none exists.

x-invariants.name: availability_boolean_projection
x-invariants.description: FOR_SALE maps to true, NOT_FOR_SALE maps to false, and UNKNOWN or CONFLICT maps to null.

x-invariants.name: deterministic_assessment_identity
x-invariants.description: assessment_identifier is the SHA-256 hash of subject scope, policy version, evidence window, and sorted observation identifiers.

x-invariants.name: sorted_observation_references
x-invariants.description: Evidence observation identifiers are unique and sorted in ascending bytewise order before identity hashing and serialization.

x-invariants.name: relationship_endpoints_exist
x-invariants.description: Emit each relationship only after both referenced endpoint records exist; the optional property reference must be independently established.
